model_meta.system_name: Hydraulically Locking Limited Slip Differential Assembly
model_meta.description: Inferred concept model of a motor-vehicle limited-slip differential assembly using an externally located pump and controller to selectively hydraulically engage an internal differential clutch.

subsystems.description: Retains the differential; the differential is arranged rotatably inside it.
Supports differential components and rotates within the housing.
Located within the carrier and drives vehicle wheels.
Located within the carrier and selectively prevents slip between wheels by coupling differential elements.
Located within the carrier and receives fluid pressure to selectively engage the clutch.
Stationary relative to the housing and external to the carrier; supplies fluid through a pathway to the pressure chamber.
External to the carrier; selectively activates the pump in response to detected slip between wheels.
At least two support bearings support the differential carrier at its interface with the housing; the fluid pathway extends across and under at least one bearing.
Optional dependent-claim feature arranged rotatably on the carrier, attaching to the pump and providing a circumferential pocket communicating with the fluid pathway.
Optional dependent-claim feature between the plenum pocket and carrier.
External drivetrain elements driven by the differential gear-set; wheel slip is the condition prompting pump activation.

item_flows.name: Pressurized working fluid
item_flows.notes: Pump delivery to pressure chamber via fluid pathway routed across/under a support bearing; optional plenum pocket communicates with the pathway.

item_flows.name: Detected wheel-slip information
item_flows.notes: Input to controller; detection source is not specified by the claims.

item_flows.name: Pump activation command
item_flows.notes: Controller selectively activates pump in response to detected slip.

item_flows.name: Differential drive to wheels
item_flows.notes: Gear-set drives vehicle wheels; claim 1 does not specify torque values.

actions.name: Hydraulically engage differential clutch upon detected slip

steps.description: Receive or act on detected slip between the wheels.
Selectively activate the external fluid pump in response to the detected slip.
Pump fluid through the pathway to the pressure chamber, selectively engaging the clutch to prevent slip between the wheels.
